referrerLists.keptReceipt: {names} still {count, plural, one {lists} other {list}} it under a list for another kind; {count, plural, one {that page flags} other {those pages flag}} it.

validatorIssues.unclosedFrontmatter: The info block at the top of the file (frontmatter) never closes, so this document does not reach the map.
validatorIssues.emptyKind: The kind value is empty: it won't be recognized as a graph node.
validatorIssues.missingKind: No kind: this document isn't a graph node yet.
validatorIssues.unknownKind: This kind isn't one of the recognized values: it may not show up in the graph.
validatorIssues.missingExpectedField: A field this kind expects (e.g. domain) is empty: the tree can't find its parent.
validatorIssues.nonCanonicalGraphArray: A relation list isn't sorted/deduplicated: it can be cleaned up automatically.
validatorIssues.parseZeroKeys: There is an info block at the top of the file, but no values could be read from it. Check the formatting.
validatorIssues.missingUid: This document has no unique id (uid). Every document needs one id that never changes, so a rename still points at the same document.
validatorIssues.invalidUid: This unique id (uid) has the wrong format. Don’t build it from the address or the title: use the value a tool generates.
validatorIssues.duplicateUid: Another document already uses this unique id (uid).
validatorIssues.invalidMergedUids: merged_uids is malformed: it must list absorbed nodes' UUIDv4s.
validatorIssues.nonCanonicalMergedUids: merged_uids is not a sorted, duplicate-free set.
validatorIssues.malformedFrontmatterLine: One line in the info block could not be read. Check the colon and the spacing on that line.
validatorIssues.malformedQuotedScalar: A quoted value in the info block never closes its quote. Add the missing quote mark.
validatorIssues.definitionMissing: There is no sentence yet saying what this concept is. One sentence that does not restate the title is enough.
validatorIssues.boundaryMissing: It does not yet say what it includes and what it leaves out. One line each under Includes and Excludes is enough.
validatorIssues.uncertaintyMissing: It does not yet say what could not be checked. One line under Uncertainty is enough.
validatorIssues.epistemicExclusion: An Excludes line says there is no evidence. That is an unknown, not a product boundary, so move it to Uncertainty.
validatorIssues.slugOutsideKindFolder: This document sits outside its kind folder. Move it inside so it groups with its kind.
validatorIssues.folderOnlyEvidence: The evidence points only at a folder, so a code change cannot be checked. Name the one file to open first.
validatorIssues.dependencyUnwitnessed: It says it depends on something, but the cited file shows no trace of it. Name the file and line that shows it, or remove the relation if it came from a name.

frontmatterBlock.codeLocationsConsumerHelp: Atlas checks each of these paths against the connected code folder. A path that is not there leaves this document waiting for a look instead of confirmed against the code.
frontmatterBlock.relationsConsumerHelp: Each of these lines becomes one connection on the map. Folder validation reports a target no document in this folder answers to: it warns, it does not block the file.

frontmatterBlock.notOnMapTitle: This document is not on the map: its kind is not set
frontmatterBlock.notOnMapBody: Set a kind and this document becomes a node on the map that agents can cite.

desktopWelcome.title: Open or create a local workspace
desktopWelcome.body: Choose a markdown folder for the workspace. Ontology Atlas keeps the files on this Mac, remembers recent workspaces, and turns document properties into a meaning graph.
desktopWelcome.dogfoodTitle: Open the folder the Ontology Atlas team uses
desktopWelcome.dogfoodBody: To see the ontology the Ontology Atlas team actually keeps while building it, pick the docs/ontology folder inside your checkout of the repository.
desktopWelcome.contractFilesBody: Your `.md` files remain in the folder you choose. Git can review every graph change.
desktopWelcome.contractGraphValue: The info block at the top is the map
desktopWelcome.contractGraphBody: Document kinds and relation names connect browse, the map, save/edit, and verification views.
desktopWelcome.contractAgentBody: Claude Code, Codex and Cursor must pass the same local graph check before writing.
desktopWelcome.openBody: Select a folder that already contains markdown documents.
desktopWelcome.dogfoodOpenBody: Select the docs/ontology folder in this repo to dogfood Atlas itself.
desktopWelcome.dogfoodDirectBody: Open docs/ontology directly in the desktop app so Atlas analyzes itself.
desktopWelcome.createBody: Make or choose an empty folder, then seed it with the starter after it opens.
desktopWelcome.sampleBody: Look around with read-only docs before choosing a local folder.
desktopWelcome.recentEmpty: No recent workspaces yet. Open or create a folder to pin it here.

sourceContract.ariaLabel: Where this workspace reads from right now

sourceContract.agentBody: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and terminal sessions run the same graph checks before writes, including relation-name agreement and path/project-map replay.

sourceContract.modalSubtitle: The files, the graph and the checks an AI must pass for this ontology folder, at a glance
sourceContract.filesTruncated: The folder was too large to read fully: pick a narrower document folder.
